## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (English only)
- [ ] `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` pass (backend)
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `vitest` pass (frontend, if touched)
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing on **both** SQLite and PostgreSQL
- [ ] Coverage stays at or above 70%
- [ ] An ADR was added/updated if this is a significant architectural decision
- [ ] Schema changes go through Alembic
- [ ] No non-English text in source code
